title: Ukuwela Eceleni Kogu
intro: Umi esihlabathini sogwini olukhohliwe, lapho amagagasi ehlebeza umphakathi ovivinywa ngomyalo waphezulu. Umoya ugcwele inkumbulo yokwephulwa okwaholela ekuguqulweni okumangalisayo. Yayingobani le miphefumulo, futhi yayiluhlobo luni lovivinyo lwayo?
clues: Sasiwumphakathi owathola umyalo ocacile eNkosini yethu, kodwa sathola izindlela zokuwuphikisa.
Sasihlala eduze kwamanzi, futhi indlela yethu yokuphila yayixhomeke ezidalweni zawo.
Uvivinyo lwafika kithi ngosuku esayalwa ngalo ukuba sigweme izinto zasemhlabeni.
Izidalwa zamanzi zeza kithi ngobuningi ngalolo suku, zisilinga ngaphezu kokukhuthazela.
Sakha icebo lobuqili lokugwema umyalo kaNkulunkulu, sicabanga ukuthi singawudlula ngobuqili lowo mthetho.
Ukweqa kwethu umthetho kwaholela ekuguqukeni okuhlazisayo; saba yizinkawu ezidelelekile ngomyalo ka-Allah.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
